name: verify-code
title: Verify code
description: The one-time code screen of a manga auth flow, made only with mangacn. A manga Panel shows a reader drawn whole in SVG (ink lines, paper fills, a screentone jacket) holding the email that just arrived, focus SpeedLines around her, 'ピコン' Sfx lettering and a SpeechBubble that reacts: 'Check your inbox!', a shout bubble 'Huh?!' on error, 'Yes!' on success. From 48rem of container width the panel sits on the start side at the full height of the form; under it the panel is a 4:3 picture above the form. The form, in a case (G1) when there is room: InputOTP with one group of 6 digits (fits 360px), a Button with its loading state, a resend link after a 30 s countdown (only the end and the resend are announced) and 'Use another email'. Fewer than six digits shows a Field error; the wrong code 000000 shows the G8 error box (accent fill, edge-jagged, '!' mark, shake, role=alert) and the InputOTP invalid look, focus back in the code; any other full code loads, then the success Stamp lands with the next action. The purpose prop (sign-in, sign-up, reset) changes the copy, the stamp ('Welcome back!', 'Welcome!', 'Verified!') and the next screen. Links call onNavigate and never navigate by themselves. One column on phones with 44px touch targets; container queries widen it. Works in light, dark, any accent and with Radix or Base UI.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/verify-code". The root fills its container width; the panel and the form sit side by side once the block is 48rem wide. Replace the simulated timeout in check() with your own verification call, and resend() with your own resend call. Pass onNavigate to wire 'Use another email' and the reset flow's next step to your router.

meta.tagline: Six digits, a resend countdown and a stamp when the code is right.
meta.usage:
import { VerifyCode } from "@/components/manga/blocks/verify-code"

<VerifyCode purpose="sign-in" email="mika@inkwell.app" onNavigate={(screen) => router.push(`/${screen}`)} />

props.name: purpose
props.description: What the code confirms: changes the copy, the stamp and the next step (reset goes on to reset-password).

props.name: email
props.description: The address the code was sent to.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called by 'Use another email' (back to sign-in, sign-up or forgot-password) and, for reset, by 'Choose a new password'. Without it they do nothing.

props.name: onContinue
props.description: Called by the button shown once a sign-in or sign-up code is accepted.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and placement of the whole interface.
